name: p1-drawn-step
from: One s8-soak-hidden pair run with the P1 drawn-position probe and the render-hop wait/work split. Same machine and conditions as the frozen baseline, except that it ran once, not twenty times.
note: A single run: no repeatability verdicts. Use it as the first measured baseline for guest.drawn_remote_step_ms and host.tick_ms.renderHopWait/Work, to be replaced by a full session before Improve claims a change. Every other metric agrees with the frozen baseline within its spread (host late ticks 1.6%, tick interval p95 21.0 ms).
